labels.t_mem:
Write to the in-memory
buffer and, at the same
time, to the os cache
labels.t_refresh: Every 1s, refresh to the os cache
labels.t_data:
Once data is refreshed to
the os cache, it becomes
searchable; the in-memory
buffer is then cleared
labels.t_5s:
Every 5s, write to the translog
(so a machine crash may lose 5s of data)
labels.t_flush:
When the translog grows
past a threshold, commit
(flush) is triggered
labels.t_list:
1. Flush the buffer data to the os cache
2. Force fsync the os cache to the
segment file, and write the commit point
3. Clear the translog and start a new one
labels._title: ES write internals: data goes through the in-memory buffer and os cache into segment files, with the translog and commit point ensuring durability
labels._desc: A write reaches the primary shard and goes into the in-memory buffer and the translog; a refresh every second moves it to the os cache where it is searchable, and a flush fsyncs it to segment files and writes a commit point.
